project_overview: This Vue.js application appears to manage exam-related processes, including registration, results, and mark sheet generation. The application structure centers around distinct view components, organized by functionality (e.g., `ApplicationServices`, `ExamFormSubmission`, `ResultPage`). The use of Vue Router suggests a focused navigation structure, driving state transitions between these components. It exhibits a degree of code duplication, particularly with variations in `iLikeCourses` related files.

Responsible for managing data retrieval, transformation, and any complex business logic. (Not explicitly defined in provided files).

macro_trends.title: Low-Level Vue Imports into High-Level Views
macro_trends.description: The dependency graph reveals instances where lower-level Vue components (e.g., `uploadFile.vue`) are directly imported and utilized within higher-level components like `ResultPage.vue`. This can introduce coupling and makes refactoring more difficult, increasing the risk of breaking changes. Potential for inconsistencies in state management between components.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission and Result Processing
key_workflows.description: The flow begins with user input via `ExamFormSubmission.vue`, potentially validated and processed.  `ResultPage.vue` then displays the resulting marksheet through integration with `viewMarksheet.vue` triggering a data-driven rendering process. The integration is facilitated by `Transactions.vue`
